sentences.text:
Dipak Joyaddar @ Dipu Joardar vs Unknown on 5 February,
2025
05.02.2025.
 65.
Ct. No. 28
 Sg
 C.R.M. (A) 222 of 2025

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 482
 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in
 connection with Nabadwip P.S. Case No. 452 of 2023 dated
 18.08.2023 under Sections 498A/326/307/34 of Ipc.
 And
In the matter of : Dipak Joyaddar @ Dipu Joardar.

1.
Learned Advocate-on-record for the petitioner submits his client does not want to proceed with the instant application for anticipatory bail.
2. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail stands dismissed as not pressed.

(Subhendu Samanta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
